decision_logic.BLOCK: population mismatch, R3 regression, temporal violation, firewall failure
decision_logic.KEEP_MC2_E: primary CI low > 0 AND all non-degradation margins hold AND coverage exact AND temporal coherence (>=2 folds point>=fold_neutral_point, no fold CI high<fold_degradation)
decision_logic.KEEP_SIMPLER: E fails but simplest of B/C/D meeting the same bar passes (checked B, then C, then D)
decision_logic.RETAIN_R3: no arm meets the bar and no BLOCK condition

n_runs.pilot: 6 checkpoints (EARLY/MID/LATE x 2 seasons, deterministic), arm E seeds S/S+1, mean winner-TV between repeats < 0.05 else escalate whole backtest to 2000; pilot inspects no truth

population.rule: V3.2C-eligible under FOLD parameters (through Y-1) in eval seasons with truth available (results parquet present, factual winner in active roster)
population.stage_rule: leader fraction thirds (EARLY<1/3, MID<2/3, else LATE)

primary_metric.name: race-macro winner log-loss difference (A minus E)
primary_metric.overall: mean over races of race-macro A-minus-E (positive favors E)
primary_metric.race_macro: mean over evaluated checkpoints in race
primary_metric.uncertainty: race-level paired bootstrap B=2000 seed 42, 95% percentile CI

run_count_criterion: TV<=0.005 (V3.2A convention) on verdict arm across EARLY/MID/LATE x seasons at 100/500/1000/5000(/10000); recommend smallest passing n among {1000,5000,10000} else DEFER
secondary_metrics: podium Brier difference (mean (p-y)^2 over roster, race-macro, A-minus-E)
expected-finish MAE difference (R7, classified drivers, race-macro, A-minus-E)
mean RPS difference (R7 normalized, classified drivers, race-macro, A-minus-E)
winner ECE (R7 bins, descriptive, no independence claims)
top-1 / top-3 winner accuracy difference (diagnostic only)

seeds.design: paired-by-checkpoint (same states, same n, same master seed); cross-arm CRN not applicable (R3 internal streams vs MC2 mc2-ar1 domain are distinct stochastic processes; R3 engine accepts no external pool and must not be modified)

truth_policy.order: classified_position non-null intersect roster (DNFs excluded from order metrics; no favourable DNF treatment)
truth_policy.separation: truth loaded from results parquet only after simulation outputs are frozen per checkpoint; evaluation module imports no simulation state
